body.heading: About this sheet
paragraphs: Free SparkKindly Kids reading aids printable: Reading Builder 20.

Syllable-building practice for growing readers: read each word part, blend the parts together, and write how many syllables you hear. Teacher note from the delivery: syllable splits are worth a quick educator check before classroom use.

body.heading: How to use it
paragraphs: Print the sheet. Clap each word slowly — one clap per syllable — then read the parts in order, faster and faster, until the whole word pops out.

takeaway: Hearing the parts inside words is a superpower for reading — long words stop being scary when you can chop them into pieces.
supervision: Clap the first word together, syllable by syllable — rhythm makes the parts easy to hear.
safetyNotes: Print at 100% size (not "fit to page") so the sheet keeps its true size and the pictures stay the size they were drawn.
screenFreeExtension: Clap the syllables in everyone's names at dinner — who has the longest name in the family?
